name: Lingo Lift
tagline: Live lecture translation, summaries and support for English-language learners.

awards: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: A friend new to Canada struggled to follow lectures in English.
solution: Transcribes and translates lectures live into a chosen language, summarises them and offers learning support.
demo_moment: Team-described: play a lecture and read it live in another language.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 124 submissions.
Built for a specific friend's experience.

lessons: Domain-name prizes still go to projects with a clear story.
